hook.en: Of every ₹100 a company earns, how much goes on materials, how much on staff, and how much is left as profit? A common size statement answers this at a glance.
hook.kn: ಕಂಪನಿ ಗಳಿಸುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ₹100ರಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಚ್ಚಾ ವಸ್ತುಗಳಿಗೆ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿಗೆ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಲಾಭವಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ? ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆ ಇದನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ನೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Prepare a common size Statement of Profit and Loss
Prepare a common size Balance Sheet

narration.en: Of every ₹100 a company earns, how much goes on materials, how much on staff, and how much is left as profit? A common size statement answers this at a glance.
narration.kn: ಕಂಪನಿ ಗಳಿಸುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ₹100ರಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಚ್ಚಾ ವಸ್ತುಗಳಿಗೆ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿಗೆ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಲಾಭವಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ? ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆ ಇದನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ನೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Each item is expressed as a percentage of a common base: revenue from operations for the Statement of Profit and Loss, and total assets (= total equity and liabilities) for the Balance Sheet. Columns: Particulars, Note No., Absolute amounts, Percentage of the base, often for two years side by side. It is a tool of vertical analysis.
body.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟದ ತಃಖ್ತೆಗೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ ಆದಾಯ ನೂರು, ಆಸ್ತಿ-ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ತಃಖ್ತೆಗೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಆಸ್ತಿ ನೂರು.

narration.en: In a common size statement, revenue from operations is one hundred for the profit and loss statement, and total assets is one hundred for the balance sheet.
narration.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟದ ತಃಖ್ತೆಗೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ ಆದಾಯ ನೂರು, ಆಸ್ತಿ-ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ತಃಖ್ತೆಗೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಆಸ್ತಿ ನೂರು.

title.en: On the board: Common size statement

narration.en: In a common size statement of profit and loss, revenue is the base: one hundred per cent.

say.en: In a common size statement of profit and loss, revenue is the base: one hundred per cent.
Each expense is divided by eight lakh: materials sixty, employees ten, other expenses five per cent.
What is left before tax is twenty-five per cent. Tax takes seven point five.
So out of every hundred rupees of revenue, seventeen rupees fifty is profit after tax.

title.en: Try it: common size Balance Sheet

caption.en: Change the assets of a firm. Each is shown as a percentage of total assets, the base of a common size Balance Sheet.

narration.en: Common size percentages always add up to one hundred, so a bigger slice for one asset means smaller slices for the others.

tryThis.en: Double the cash only: why do all the other percentages fall?
Which item would a trading firm usually show larger than a factory?

problem.en: Revenue from operations ₹8,00,000; cost of materials consumed ₹4,80,000; employee benefits ₹80,000; other expenses ₹40,000; tax 30% of profit. Prepare a common size Statement of Profit and Loss.

steps.en: Revenue = 100%. Materials 4,80,000 ÷ 8,00,000 = 60%; employee benefits 10%; other expenses 5%.

answer.en: Out of every ₹100 of revenue, ₹17.50 is profit after tax.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.

problem.en: Total assets ₹20,00,000: PPE ₹12,00,000; inventories ₹3,00,000; trade receivables ₹4,00,000; cash ₹1,00,000. Find the common size percentages.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.
Revenue from operations is ₹4,00,000. What cost of goods sold shows as 60% in a common-size statement?

prompt.en: Revenue from operations is ₹4,00,000. What cost of goods sold shows as 60% in a common-size statement?

explanation.en: Each item as a % of revenue: 2,40,000 / 4,00,000 = 60%.

narration.en: Team quiz. Each team discusses and agrees on one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ಆರಿಸಲಿ.

points.en: Common size statements express items as % of a common base.
points.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆಗಳು ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಆಧಾರದ ಶೇಕಡಾವಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Base: revenue from operations (P&L), total assets (Balance Sheet).
points.kn: ಆಧಾರ: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ ಆದಾಯ (ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ), ಒಟ್ಟು ಆಸ್ತಿ (ಆಸ್ತಿ-ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ತಃಖ್ತೆ).

points.en: It is vertical analysis and helps compare firms of different sizes.
points.kn: ಇದು ಲಂಬ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ; ಬೇರೆ ಗಾತ್ರದ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: Prepare a common size Balance Sheet for any two years of a company of your choice.

narration.en: Recap. Common size statements express items as % of a common base. Base: revenue from operations (P&L), total assets (Balance Sheet). It is vertical analysis and helps compare firms of different sizes.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆಗಳು ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಆಧಾರದ ಶೇಕಡಾವಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಆಧಾರ: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ ಆದಾಯ (ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ), ಒಟ್ಟು ಆಸ್ತಿ (ಆಸ್ತಿ-ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ತಃಖ್ತೆ). ಇದು ಲಂಬ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ; ಬೇರೆ ಗಾತ್ರದ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
